name: poland_5000
description: Polish settlement terminal set (5000 largest places by population) for idealized FGO experiments.
source: GeoNames Poland dump (PL.zip), download.geonames.org, retrieved 2026-11-17; see docs/data.md

metadata.selection: Polish populated places (feature class P, excluding sections PPLX and historical/abandoned places, plus city districts recorded as standalone places) with population > 0, ranked by population
metadata.notes: Coordinates are approximate settlement centres, not station locations. Nested prefix of the poland_5000 ranking.
